text: Leading our green news today, there's incredible progress happening in Houston's Fifth Ward where new air quality monitors have just been installed. This majority Black and Hispanic neighbourhood has been fighting for cleaner air for years and they've finally got the tools to make real change.

speaker: charlie
text: That's brilliant mate. These aren't just fancy gadgets either - they're giving the community hard data to push for stronger regulations. Sometimes you need those numbers to make the bureaucrats listen, don't you?

speaker: alice
text: Absolutely right Alex. And speaking of community power, we're seeing elephants returning to eastern Zambia for the first time in over fifty years! Local communities are working with conservationists to build elephant-proof grain stores and learning to live alongside their new massive neighbours.
